key.inventorykit.shift: Shift Inventory Rows (hold Shift to reverse)
key.inventorykit.shift_column: Shift Selected Column (hold Shift to reverse)
key.inventorykit.toggle_lock: Lock or Unlock Slot (selected, or under the mouse)
key.inventorykit.search: Search Items (in chests and the inventory)
button.inventorykit.deposit_matching.too:
Deposit matching items
Moves items that this container already holds. Locked slots stay.
button.inventorykit.deposit_all.tooltip:
Deposit everything
Empties your inventory into this container. Locked slots stay.
button.inventorykit.take_matching.toolti:
Take matching items
Takes items that you already carry.
button.inventorykit.take_all.tooltip:
Take everything
Empties this container into your inventory.
button.inventorykit.sort.tooltip.categor:
Sort by category
Shift-click to sort by name instead.
button.inventorykit.sort.tooltip.name:
Sort by name
Shift-click to sort by category instead.
button.inventorykit.search.tooltip:
Search items (%s)
Type to highlight matching items. Enter keeps the filter, Esc clears it.
config.inventorykit.title: Inventory Kit
config.inventorykit.skip_empty.descripti: Jump past rows that are completely empty, so the hotbar never lands on nothing. If every other row is empty, shifting does nothing.
config.inventorykit.column_modifier.desc: Hold this while pressing the shift key to move only the column of the selected hotbar slot.
config.inventorykit.scroll_enabled.descr: Hold the scroll modifier and scroll to shift. Scrolling down moves the rows down, scrolling up moves them back.
config.inventorykit.scroll_modifier.desc: The key to hold while scrolling.
config.inventorykit.scroll_target.descri: Whether scrolling moves every row or only the column of the selected hotbar slot.
config.inventorykit.preview_mode.descrip: Shows the row that the next shift brings into the hotbar. Hold Shift to see the row for the reverse direction.
config.inventorykit.preview_offset.descr: Raises the preview strip by this many pixels. Negative values lower it.
config.inventorykit.sound.description: Play a soft pop when the inventory shifts.
config.inventorykit.animation.descriptio: Make the items that arrive in the hotbar bounce, like items being picked up.
config.inventorykit.container_buttons.de: Show the deposit, take, sort and search buttons on chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers and the inventory. Takes effect the next time a screen opens.
config.inventorykit.sort_mode.descriptio: Category uses the order of the creative menu. Shift-clicking a sort button switches this too.
Whether the deposit buttons also move items from the hotbar. Locked hotbar slots are never emptied.
config.inventorykit.group.locked.descrip: A locked slot is never shifted, deposited or sorted. These are the hotbar slots; to lock any other inventory slot, point at it in an inventory screen and press the lock key. Locked slots show a padlock.
config.inventorykit.sort_mode.name: Name
button.inventorykit.undo.tooltip:
Undo
Puts everything back where it was before the last deposit, take or sort.
config.inventorykit.protect_in_use: Don't shift while using an item
config.inventorykit.protect_in_use.descr: Ignore the shift keys while you are eating, aiming a bow, blocking or mining, so the item is not swapped out of your hand.
config.inventorykit.clicks_per_tick.desc: On servers, sorting and moving items is spread out at this many clicks per tick, so it does not look like cheating. 0 sends everything at once. Single player always sends everything at once.
